title: Stage-3 behaviour-oracle + blast-radius gate outcome
description: The versioned machine-readable verdict emitted by oracle_gate.evaluate_oracle for one edit task and its reference (oracle) patch. It carries FOUR independently versioned sub-outcomes -- existing_suite, discrimination, changed_path and api_impact -- each with its own schema tag and its own stable reason code. Deterministic and byte-stable: changed paths, impacted symbols and escaped references are sorted before emit. FAILS CLOSED -- a timeout, a missing command, a tool error, a patch that escapes the declared blast radius, a non-discriminating or wrong-direction test, or an absent forged corpus all yield passed=false with the exact reason code and BOUNDED captured output.

passed.description: True only when all four sub-gates passed.

diagnostic.description: Human-readable summary; leads with the first failing sub-gate's reason code.

reason.description: Stable reason-code enum shared across all sub-gates. The per-gate passing codes are SUITE_GREEN, DISCRIMINATES, WITHIN_SCOPE and NO_ESCAPE; every other code is a fail-closed condition.

command_run.description: The bounded result of running one argv. exit_code is null when the command never produced one (timeout, missing binary, os error).

reason.$comment: null on a clean run; else TIMEOUT / COMMAND_NOT_FOUND / TOOL_FAILURE / COMMAND_ABSENT

observed.description: green = exit 0, red = nonzero exit, error = the run failed closed with a reason.

existing_suite.description: The repository's DECLARED existing test suite, run once on the patched tree as a regression guard -- separate from the task-specific discrimination test.

discrimination.description: The red->green discrimination proof: the behaviour command run on the pristine tree (must be RED) and again on the oracle-patched tree (must be GREEN). Same-direction (both green / both red) and wrong-direction (green pristine) outcomes are REJECTED.

changed_path.description: Declared changed-path (blast radius) enforcement. Every file the oracle patch touches must match at least one blast_radius.allow glob and stay within any max_files cap.

changed.description: Sorted set of patch-touched relative paths.

out_of_scope.description: Sorted subset of changed paths matching no allow glob.

api_impact.description: Public-API / call-hierarchy blast-radius check. For each symbol the patch changes, references are resolved with LCI; any reference living OUTSIDE the declared allow scope is an escape (the edit rippled past its declared blast radius).

symbols.description: Sorted set of impacted symbols queried.

escaped_refs.description: Sorted references that fall outside the declared allow scope.
